output_list.reason: The mint function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The totalSupply + _value <= TOKEN_LIMIT check is bypassed if _value is crafted to push totalSupply past the TOKEN_LIMIT.
The transfer function allows the owner to transfer funds to any address, including a compromised exchange, allowing attackers to steal funds.
The transferFrom function allows the owner to transfer funds to any address, including a compromised exchange, allowing attackers to steal funds.
The approve function allows the owner to approve an arbitrary number of tokens for any address, including a compromised exchange, allowing attackers to steal funds.
The Typo Constructor function has a typo in it, allowing attackers to exploit it and steal funds.
